title: VNI SelectionPolicy v1
description: Canonical SelectionPolicy for the ERC-8004 Validation Network Interface (VNI), Draft v0.2. This schema describes the logical decoding of the ABI-encoded `policy` bytes passed to IValidationNetwork.submit()/supportsPolicy()/quote(). The on-chain wire format is the ABI encoding of the SelectionPolicy struct; this JSON Schema documents the field semantics, types, and the constraints expressible without cross-field arithmetic. Cross-field constraints (minOperators <= selectionSize, minResponses <= selectionSize) are NORMATIVE in the spec but not enforceable by JSON Schema alone; see allOf notes below.

version.description: Policy schema version. MUST be 1 for this revision. Networks MUST treat any unrecognized version as unsupported and supportsPolicy() MUST return false.

selectionSize.description: N: number of validators to select. MUST be >= 1. uint8 on the wire.

minOperators.description: D: minimum distinct operators across the selected set. MUST be <= selectionSize. Enforced at SELECTION time, not response time. A network whose effective operator count is below this MUST return false from supportsPolicy(). uint8 on the wire.

minResponses.description: M: minimum attestations required for a valid aggregated response. MUST be <= selectionSize. uint8 on the wire.

deadlineSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget in seconds from submit() to aggregated response. uint64 on the wire. Values above 2^53-1 cannot be represented exactly as a JSON number; serializers MAY encode this field as a decimal string for off-chain transport.

verdictMode.description: Aggregation rule. 0 = any-pass, 1 = majority, 2 = unanimous. uint8 on the wire.

challengeKind.description: Network-defined kind tag, e.g. keccak256("rpc-equivalence-v1"). 32-byte hex value. bytes32 on the wire.

extensions.description: Network-specific opaque field. For canonical policies this MUST decode to empty (the zero-length byte string, hex "0x"). Network-aware clients MAY pack additional ABI-encoded fields here; canonical decoders ignore the remainder.

allOf.$comment: NORMATIVE cross-field constraint (not machine-enforced here): minOperators MUST be <= selectionSize.
NORMATIVE cross-field constraint (not machine-enforced here): minResponses MUST be <= selectionSize.
